Delete your account

To request deletion of your Power Training Coach account and all associated data, send us an email from the address linked to your account.

Deleting your account permanently removes:

  • Your profile, login, and questionnaire answers
  • Your training plans and training history
  • Your forum posts, comments, and saved posts
  • Your subscription and consultation booking records

We process deletion requests within 30 days.
